verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source library that runs locally via AsyncWebCrawler, needs no forced API keys, and ships an optimized Docker image with a FastAPI server. A dedicated self-hosting docs section exists, and community posts confirm the open-source nature and describe Docker-based setups. missing for 10: explicit license terms in the evidence, detailed first-party self-hosting deployment docs content beyond the section reference

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Dockerized Setup: Optimized Docker image with FastAPI server for easy deployment.
Open Source: No forced API keys, no paywalls—everyone can access their data.
Crawl4AI is an amazing open-source library that solves many LLM-scraping headaches.
